statement: Under GNU FDL 1.3 section 3, publishing or distributing more than 100 Opaque copies requires either a machine-readable Transparent copy with each Opaque copy or a network location stated in or with each copy. In the network route, the general network-using public must be able to download a complete Transparent copy free of added material using public-standard network protocols. The distributor must take reasonably prudent steps at the start of distribution in quantity to keep it accessible there until at least one year after the last public distribution of an Opaque copy of that edition.
